C2_difference_from_C1: 24^3 grid (13824 candidates); dose-response, secondary, never a gate
anchor_control: anchor RGB + anchor depth, the same full-role bounds as the variant's A/B state; a single view never reaches the >=2-view lifting support, so an anchor state carries the single-view depth bypass and learned priors only

depth_bypass.inputs: context RGB, measured context depth, context cameras; no query
depth_bypass.placement: after the >=2-view support gate: one measured view suffices
depth_bypass.sampling: nearest pixel of the full-resolution measured ray-distance map

only_difference_C0_C1: C1 differs from C0 only by the voxel grid, 32^3 instead of 16^3, with one dense evidence candidate per voxel; the 5150 shared parameters and their per-seed draw, the V5 C1 model and loss, TRAIN72, 6000 steps and the bounds rule (CONTEXT_DEPTH: hull of the measured context depth and context cameras, anchor frame, frozen x1.1 padding, >=1 m) are identical, in training and in evaluation. The depth-likelihood scale follows each grid's own mean voxel edge (the V5 definition); the surface-loss band keeps the frozen 16-grid spacing.
state: query-independent; all DEV states sealed before query load; >=2 queries/state
